fit.intro: Four measurements, taken barefoot. We set size, cockpit and crank length to match.
fit.how_inseam: Stand with your back to a wall, feet 15 cm apart. Pull a book firmly up between your legs, spine against the wall. Measure from the floor to the top of the book.
fit.how_arm: Arm hanging straight: from the bony point at the top of your shoulder to the centre of your closed fist.
fit.how_shoulders: Between the bony points at the top of both shoulders. Sets the bar width.
fit.footnote: A starting point from your measurements, not a fitting. Geometry:
fit.figure_title: How to measure: height, inseam with a book, arm length from shoulder to closed fist, shoulder width
